chunks: "By Allah, they have succeeded with rewards that are unlike the rewards of the servants."

key_terms.الْعِبَادِ: human beings or servants, whose rewards are limited unlike Allah’s
key_terms.وَ اللَّهِ: an oath emphasizing certainty and truthfulness

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the unique rewards granted by Allah?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdullah Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام declares that certain people have attained true success through rewards granted by Allah, not rewards of ordinary human giving. The wording emphasizes the incomparable and elevated nature of divine recompense, especially in a context of worship and devotion.
